text: N072100September 9, 2009CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:WA 356 CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6110.20.2069 Ms. Tammy L. Reagan    Top Apparel d.b.a. One Stop2686 Northridge Drive NW  Grand Rapids, MI 49544RE:	The tariff classification of a men’s knit pullover garment from PakistanDear Ms. Reagan:In your letter dated July 23, 2009, and in subsequent correspondence received on August 14, 2009, you requested a tariff classification ruling.  Your sample is being retained for our files.Style EZI01, which is identified as an “Urban Ribbed Tank,” is a men’s pullover garment that is constructed from 100% cotton, 2x2 rib knit fabric that measures 24 stitches per two centimeters counted in the horizontal direction.  Style EZ101 is cut and sewn and has a low, round front neckline; a high rear neckline; oversized armholes; and a straight, hemmed bottom.  The garment is imported in men’s sizes S - 2X in white, black and grey.   The garment is not considered a tank top because the high rear neckline does not allow the formation of shoulder straps on the back panel.  Consequently, the applicable subheading for Style EZ101 will be 6110.20.2069, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States, (HTSUS), which provides for: sweaters, pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar articles, knitted or crocheted: of cotton: other: other: other: other: men's or boys'.  The duty rate is 16.5% ad valorem. This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).  A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Mary Ryan at 646-733-3271.Sincerely,Robert B. SwierupskiDirectorNational Commodity Specialist Division
